ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 in chat on 21 November 2026 for Grain 0.1.1-experimental (PR #1962). Asked to approve 0.1.1 under the same exception as 0.1.0, with the same waivers plus the pool fix and a meter cost of 17, and whether to ask the author: "yes to all four, waive the author OK". Then: "Ok, let's bring the base and the new grain version live!!". Asked whether to keep 0.1.0's screenshots, since 0.1.1 draws nothing new, under a release-documentation waiver: "Waive, keep 0.1.0's".
reason: Grain 0.1.1-experimental, exact native source only (package 1b3728c0…, MKII OS 1.40C): 0.1.0's source plus two changes. The pool audition: only a START carrying the audition flag (0x20; FUNC+YES in the pool, 0xe0 against a sequencer trig's 0xc0 on the owner's MKII) plays the track as a plain Flex, until its next trig, so opening the pool no longer stops Grain. The descriptor names the CPU meter Grain adds, 17 points (reserved[1], resources.cpuMeter): +8.9 measured on the owner's Part at PTCH +24, SIZE and DENS 127 on a 16-bit stereo sample, and +14.5 to +16.5 in 0.1.0's record for dense six-voice 24-bit stereo. On the owner's MKII in RAM: build c841ea87 (this source but for the meter byte) kept Grain rendering with the pool open, took the plain path for a held FUNC+YES and returned on the next trig; package 1b3728c0 was picked and played on T1 on a development twin of base 0.7.13 and loaded and rolled back on the exact 0.7.13 release image. Release documentation is waived: 0.1.1 draws nothing new, so its screenshots are 0.1.0's. The other waivers stay as for 0.1.0: the static zero-wait bound exceeds the frame budget (chip worst-case cycles), no full memory-region inventory (complete memory bounds), and the MIDI flood counted no stuck notes after a channel change and no end-to-end losses (current-build hardware). Known limits: after a pool opened on the Grain track from a page other than SRC and closed, FUNC+SRC cannot pick FLEX or STATIC until SRC or another track is shown; the clicks on every trig at SIZE 86, DENS 127, TRI and SYNC are still being investigated. Not tested: the audition's sound, project save and reload, a full module set, MKI and the owner's listening check. The author's OK for this update was waived by the owner. This exception applies to no other version or source.
